_comment: Mission presets for the UI. Weights map to Terrain (T), Thermal (H), Material (M), Water and ice (W), Biology (B), Construction (C), Atmosphere and dust (A), and Illumination (I).

profiles.name: Balanced (default)
profiles.purpose: Compare sites across the core physical dimensions without prioritizing one mission goal.

profiles.name: Lunar south-pole operations
profiles.purpose: Assess terrain, low-angle light and ice-related conditions for polar surface operations.

profiles.name: Base construction and site preparation
profiles.purpose: Find places to test grading, foundations, excavation and construction equipment.

profiles.name: Water-ice prospecting
profiles.purpose: Compare terrain and thermal conditions relevant to finding and measuring buried ice.

profiles.name: Mars sample science and astrobiology
profiles.purpose: Compare rocks, water history and biological context for sample collection and biosignature work.

profiles.name: Rover mobility and navigation
profiles.purpose: Find terrain and surface conditions relevant to driving, traction and route planning.
